title: Cantor Fitzgerald Income Trust, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Cantor Fitzgerald Income Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 10, 2026, disclosing the issuance of 920,000 shares of 9.50% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock (ticker CFTR-PRA) listed on NYSE, along with amendments to the company's limited partnership agreement to create corresponding Series A Preferred Units.
key_points: Cantor Fitzgerald Income Trust, Inc. issued 920,000 shares of 9.50% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock via underwritten public offering
The preferred stock (ticker CFTR-PRA) is listed on NYSE and will rank senior to common stock regarding dividend rights and liquidation preferences
Amendment No. 1 to the Limited Partnership Agreement was executed on April 8, 2026, establishing Series A Preferred Units
Articles Supplementary were filed with the Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation on April 6, 2026
The company is incorporated in Maryland with ticker symbol not disclosed in filing; registered file number 001-43220
Christopher A. Milner signed as President on April 10, 2026
